name: the maximum plus one minor unit
why: above the SEPA Credit Transfer maximum, 99999999999 minor units (999999999.99 EUR)

name: 12 digits
why: above the SEPA Credit Transfer maximum

name: the int8 maximum
why: above the SEPA Credit Transfer maximum, though a balance could hold it

name: 20 digits
why: above the SEPA Credit Transfer maximum (and too long for any amount)

name: zero
why: must be positive (the rulebook: 0,00 euro is not allowed)

name: a leading zero
why: no leading zero: one spelling per amount

name: a JSON number
why: amounts are strings of digits, never JSON numbers
